module: Career tutorial step 3 ("basicManeuvers"): the player drives freely (message about changing camera) then must park the vehicle in the parking spot named simpleCourseStart (marker + ground decal). The objective is validated when the vehicle stays stationary in the spot for 1 s (gameplay_tutorial_markers.checkParkGoalWithStationaryTime); the next step is then activated after 1.5 s.
notes: If the simpleCourseStart spot is not found in the tutorial sites, a warning is logged and the parking objective cannot be validated.
The hooks are called by the tutorial runtime.

setup.desc: Called on activation: resets the objective, activates the evalZone zone, installs the out-of-bounds reset, then directly starts the parking phase (unlocks the gears, unfreezes the vehicle, creates the marker).

onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.desc: Out-of-bounds hook: starts the step's out-of-bounds reset.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: tests the parking objective; once validated, moves to the next step after 1.5 s.

cleanup.desc: Called at the end of the step: removes the out-of-bounds reset, clears the task list, deletes the marker and decal.

onDebugMenu.desc: Displays the objectives state and a "Skip Step 3" button (teleports the vehicle to the spot and advances).
